messages.subject: Filling space between to Lines
parts:
This is my first ggplot2 group posting.

I am trying to fill the space between two lines on a line chart.
I've searched this group and R support but haven't found an answer.

My dataframe (test) looks this:

Month variable value
1 1/1/2010 CBS 0.545
2 2/1/2010 CBS 0.522
3 3/1/2010 CBS 0.565
4 4/1/2010 CBS 0.539
5 5/1/2010 CBS 0.565
6 6/1/2010 CBS 0.611
7 7/1/2010 CBS 0.586
8 8/1/2010 CBS 0.538
9 9/1/2010 CBS 0.532
10 10/1/2010 CBS 0.511
11 11/1/2010 CBS 0.407
12 1/1/2010 Non.CBS 0.390
13 2/1/2010 Non.CBS 0.390
14 3/1/2010 Non.CBS 0.409
15 4/1/2010 Non.CBS 0.422
16 5/1/2010 Non.CBS 0.419
17 6/1/2010 Non.CBS 0.421
18 7/1/2010 Non.CBS 0.415
19 8/1/2010 Non.CBS 0.389
20 9/1/2010 Non.CBS 0.394
21 10/1/2010 Non.CBS 0.369
22 11/1/2010 Non.CBS 0.245

Here is the code for the 2-line chart:

p<-ggplot(test,aes( x=as.Date(Month,"%m/%d/
%Y") ,y=value,group=variable))

p + geom_line(aes(colour = variable))+ scale_x_date("2010",format =
"%b") + scale_y_continuous("Take
Rate",limit=c(0,.8),formatter="percent")



I would like to fill the space between the two lines. Any ideas?

I looked at geom_ribbon but I don't believe that is the appropriate
geom.

Thanks,

Bill
